items.source_title: The Effects of K-12 Artificial Intelligence Education in Enhancing AI Literacy: A Meta-Analysis
items.source_organization: Journal of Computer Assisted Learning / Wiley
items.source_locator: Abstract > Results and Conclusion; Publication History / First published
items.original_excerpt: The analysis showed a significant overall mean effect of AI education classes ( g = 0.892, CI: [0.548, 1.236], p < 0.001) on enhancing AI literacy.
items.claim_text: 一篇統合分析彙整8個資料庫中16篇K-12 AI教育課程研究（57個效果量），作者報告這些課程對提升學習者AI素養整體呈顯著正向效果，依出版類型、年份與學段的調節分析未見顯著差異；屬作者對既有研究的彙整，納入研究數有限，不能視為各地課程成效已獲驗證。
items.scope_limitation: August publication; background only, not a new October result.

items.source_title: Latent profiles of AI teaching self-efficacy and their associations with occupational well-being among vocational education teachers in China: the moderating role of AI anxiety
items.source_locator: Article page: 'Published: 09 October 2026' and citation_online_date 2026/10/09; Abstract > Methods
items.original_excerpt: A regionally stratified online survey was conducted with 768 in-service teachers (378 from secondary vocational schools, 390 from higher vocational colleges)
items.claim_text: 中國768名職業教育在職教師（中等職業學校378人、高等職業院校390人）的分層線上問卷，以潛在剖面分析探討AI教學自我效能與職業福祉的關聯及AI焦慮的調節作用；屬橫斷面相關研究，不能推論因果，且樣本過半來自大專層級。
items.scope_limitation: Accepted manuscript shared early (to be replaced by Version of Record). Mixed school levels: only 378/768 teachers are from secondary vocational schools; cross-sectional correlational survey in mainland China; effect sizes are high-risk numbers pending G2–G4. No earlier preprint found in one Crossref title query (not exhaustive). Not for publication.
items.screening_note: Discovery only, hold pending first-disclosure check.
items.ai_lit_note: 中國職業教育在職教師的AI教學自我效能與職業福祉，對應T-PD「評估教師AI素養以規劃專業增能」；樣本中職（中等職業學校，K-12）378人、高職院校（高等職業院校，大專）390人，大專略多，管理者2026-10-09決定記higher_ed。
